text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a spike in token-level NaNs in prod for flashx-v2 on A100s. Sequence ~1200+, kernel selector fell back to generic and tail latency jumped.
alex: Ugh. Did the runtime pick paged-attn or fallback-gemm? Any perf traces?
devon: I pulled a profile from that window, attaching snippet:
```
Kernel             time_ms   calls
flashx-v2          12.3      120
paged-attn-lazy    1.1       120
fused-attn-opt     3.6       60
fallback-gemm      48.7      6   <- huge time on long seqs
```
devon: The selector logs show fp8 mode enabled + quantizer tuning enabled for that model variant. We saw a softmax scaling change in the compiled kernel.
ryan: Any numeric evidence? overflow/underflow counters from the kernel?
maria: Yes. From the runtime metrics: max_logit ~ 1.2e4 at token 1187, exp() saturated -> INF, then NaN downstream. Happens only when fp8 path + kv-prefetch is on.
alex: Interesting — KV prefetcher reorders chunks so that softmax scale gets computed on concatenated tiles? Could be missing reduction/rescale when merging tiles.
devon: Repro on dev box: enable fp8 + sequence=1300 -> reproducible. Disable kv-prefetch and it's gone. Also reproducible with paged-attn-lazy when page boundary aligns with softmax window.
ci-bot: perf-run #9876 finished: benchmarks/attn/flashx-v2/fp8/longseq
ci-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/9876/profile.pb
alex: Hypothesis: quantized accumulators in fp8 path overflow because the softmax exponent isn't clamped/shifted before exp. On fp16/bf16 path we use a max-subtract; somehow fp8 compiled kernel skipped that step for paged boundaries.
maria: Priority: high. This affects hosted customers on long-document completions. We should ship a hotfix that forces a stable softmax precondition (max-subtract + small epsilon) in the fp8/paged kernels.
devon: Plan:
- Reproduce and add unit that runs seq 1400 with kv-prefetch toggled (me)
- Add instrumentation counters for max_logit and exp_overflow (alex)
- Patch fp8 kernel to apply stable softmax routine on page joins (devon + alex)
- Temp mitigation: disable kv-prefetch for fp8 models in route table (maria/ryan)
ryan: I'll put a gate in the routing policy to prefer bf16 for seq>1024 until patch lands. Also add a canary rollout to 5% of tenants.
alex: Also found a batching heuristic bug: when we merge two small requests into a continuous batch and the combined length crosses a threshold, kernel selector still picks the short-seq optimized flash kernel which doesn't handle page joins correctly. Need selector fix.
maria: Good catch. That explains some inconsistent repros.
devon: I pushed a repro test and a failing CI vector: tests/attention/longseq_fp8_prefetch.py
alex: PR incoming with extra clamp: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4207
maria: @devon @alex please coordinate to get a hotfix build out. I'm disabling fp8-prefetch routes now and will post update once rolled.
ryan: Rolling change to routing policy in 5m, will monitor error rate and latency.
maria: Thanks. Add an alert on exp_overflow counter > 1 per minute so we can catch regressions quickly :thumbsup:
alex: Will do. Also adding a small regression test in perf harness to track kernel selector behavior under batched-merge scenarios.
maria: Nice. Update thread with the build id once hotfix is published.
ci-bot: deploy job #824 queued by ryan
maria: closing loop — thanks all, looks actionable.
